source_fields.formulation: Each round reveals a context or action-feature set before an action is selected and its reward with linear mean is observed. The algorithm satisfies joint differential privacy, limiting the influence of one user's information on actions shown to other users. Contexts are i.i.d. from an unknown distribution.
source_fields.solution_goal: Minimize performance as defined by the metric, guarantee, and native resource.

source_fields.instance: Contexts $x_t$ are i.i.d. from an unknown distribution $P$. The finite action set $\mathcal A$ and feature map $\phi$ are public. The fixed unknown parameter and features lie in the Euclidean unit ball: $$\|\phi(x,a)\|_2\le1,\quad\|\theta_\star\|_2\le1,\quad Y_t\in[-1,1],\quad\mathbb E[Y_t\mid x_t,a_t,\mathcal H_{t-1}]=\langle\phi(x_t,a_t),\theta_\star\rangle.$$ Rewards are fresh draws from the current conditional law. The learner observes the context, selects an action, and then receives that action's reward. $$d_{\mathcal A}=\max_x\dim\operatorname{span}\{\phi(x,a):a\in\mathcal A\}\le\min\{d,|\mathcal A|\}.$$

operations.query_signature: Causal policies must satisfy $(\epsilon_{\mathrm{priv}},\delta_{\mathrm{priv}})$ joint differential privacy. Inputs $T,d,\mathcal A,\phi,\epsilon_{\mathrm{priv}},\delta_{\mathrm{priv}}$ are public; context distribution $P$ and reward parameter $\theta_\star$ are hidden. Exact planning and regression subroutines are allowed. Received feedback may be stored and reused computationally. No unrevealed historical information or extra queries to exhausted samples are available; any within-round full-function or common-sample access must be explicit.

Initialization and exploration are charged, with separate information, arithmetic, communication, and memory resources. No optimal arithmetic or bit complexity is asserted.

view_override_policy.limitations: Mechanical merge does not certify consistency or mathematical identity. Narrative qualifications and source conditions remain authoritative.

source_fields.randomization: Private randomness is allowed and independent of the fixed instance and future external randomness.
source_fields.adaptivity: Strictly follows the per-round and within-batch protocol of the oracle
restrictions: Neighboring streams $\mathsf D,\mathsf D^{\prime}$ differ only in one user's context/reward pair. The protected output is every action except that user's current recommendation, received privately. For every measurable event $E$, require:
$$\Pr\!\left(\mathcal M(\mathsf D)_{-t}\in E\right)\le e^{\epsilon_{\mathrm{priv}}}\Pr\!\left(\mathcal M(\mathsf D^{\prime})_{-t}\in E\right)+\delta_{\mathrm{priv}}.$$
The privacy relaxation constrains the entire output mechanism. Performance is measured in expectation, without a separate external statistical failure probability.

Private randomization is allowed, with the seed independent of the fixed instance and future external samples. Internal arithmetic, memory, linear spans, and iteration forms are unrestricted except for the stated computation, communication, privacy, and within-round interaction limits.
source_fields.internal_computation: Unrestricted except for explicit polynomial-time or protocol constraints
source_fields.parallelism: Follows the simultaneous-query, task-batch, and communication timing specified by the oracle

source_fields.complete_expression: Take the infimum over admissible jointly private policies, then the supremum over unknown i.i.d. context distributions and admissible reward environments. Expectation includes context, reward, and privacy-algorithm randomness. This is an expected-performance objective.
aggregation_order: Take the infimum over admissible jointly private policies, then the supremum over unknown i.i.d. context distributions and admissible reward environments. Expectation includes context, reward, and privacy-algorithm randomness. This is an expected-performance objective.
source_fields.quantifier_order: One admissible algorithm using only public information must handle every prescribed instance; adaptation to unknown budgets must be performed by that same algorithm.
randomness_sources: Observation or environment randomness explicitly allowed by the oracle.
source_fields.runtime_guarantee: The resource budget is fixed. Expected error is not automatically converted to high probability or a random-runtime bound.
